create_stft_magnitude_spectrogram: create a magnitude spectrogram from an input audio signal tensor using STFT with configurable FFT size and window
build_spectral_convergence_loss: build a spectral convergence loss module that computes Frobenius norm ratio between predicted and groundtruth magnitude spectrograms
create_log_stft_magnitude_loss: create a log STFT magnitude loss module that computes L1 loss between log-transformed predicted and groundtruth magnitude spectrograms
build_stft_loss_module: build an STFT loss module that combines spectral convergence and log magnitude losses for audio signal comparison
build_multi_resolution_stft_loss: build a multi-resolution STFT loss module that averages spectral convergence and log magnitude losses across multiple FFT sizes
